heading: Grandfather clause
lead: Nothing in this chapter shall abridge the right of any person, or the successor in interest of the person, to reproduce or sell a variety developed and produced by such person more than one year prior to the effective filing date of an adverse application for a certificate of plant variety protection.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1994—Pub. L. 103–349 substituted “the successor in interest of the person” for “his successor in interest”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1994 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 103–349 effective 180 days after Oct. 6, 1994, see section 15 of Pub. L. 103–349, set out as a note under section 2401 of this title.
